note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI charges a 60 pt Burna squad into a 195 pt Blade Champion that supports can reach. The squad deals about 0.7 damage and will be wiped. The gang-up bonus of 5.0 outweighs a retaliation penalty of -4.44. Fix: Make gang-up and character-kill bonuses scale with expected melee damage divided by target wounds. Set them to zero when expected damage is below about 20% of the target wounds. Raise the retaliation penalty to the full unit points value when the unit cannot hurt the target. Add a penalty for leaving a held objective.
